Base M (clear pattern), bumped to L for touching a shared security utility.

13 files changed in total (backend 7, UI 6; 768 insertions, 69 deletions): 6 source files and 7 test files, of which roughly 4 are new test files (backend per-role HTTP auth matrix, UI tabs.auditor, CostCentersManagementPage.auditor, CostCenterDetailsPage tests). 11-15 files maps to XL; test files dominate the count.

Bumped to M because the change alters authorization: auditors must gain read access without any write path leaking, which the read/write service split and the parameterized role x endpoint HTTP test matrix guard against.
